subject: general
question: Which of the following states has the oldest operating oil refinery in India since 1901?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Assam.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Assam** has the** oldest **operating** oil refinery** in India since **1901**, which is **Digboi Refinery.**
 
• It was established by the** Assam Oil Company,** which was later taken over by the** Indian Oil Corporation **in 1981.
 
• The refinery has a processing capacity of **0.65 million metric tonnes per annum **and produces various petroleum products like **petrol, diesel, kerosene, and LPG.**
 
• Digboi Refinery is also known for its historical significance as it played a vital role during **World War II **and supplied fuel for the **Allied forces.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Madhya Pradesh **has three oil refineries, namely **Bina Refinery, Bharat Oman Refinery, and Ratnagiri Refinery.**
 
• **West Bengal** has two oil refineries, namely **Haldia Refinery and Barauni Refinery.**
 
• **Mumbai** has two oil refineries, namely **Mumbai Refinery and Bina Refinery.**
